title: OCD Test
description: Recognize tendencies toward obsessive thoughts and repetitive behaviors (compulsions).

questions.ocir_1: I collect so many things that they fill up space and get in the way.
questions.ocir_2: I check things (like the stove, locks, or windows) more often than necessary.
questions.ocir_3: I get upset if others change the way I've arranged my things.
questions.ocir_4: I feel I have to count things (like my steps).
questions.ocir_5: I find it very hard to throw away things I don't actually need.
questions.ocir_6: I have unpleasant thoughts that keep coming back against my will.
questions.ocir_7: I repeat certain actions to make sure I've done them right.
questions.ocir_8: I wash my hands too much or for longer than necessary.
questions.ocir_9: I feel I have to check everything carefully and repeatedly.
questions.ocir_10: I often think about bad things that I can't get out of my head.
questions.ocir_11: I feel I have to do a routine or habit without skipping anything.
questions.ocir_12: I often think dirty, frightening, or strange things for no reason.
questions.ocir_13: I have to arrange things around me in a certain order or position to feel calm.
questions.ocir_14: I'm bothered when objects on a table or in a room aren't symmetrical or straight.
questions.ocir_15: I repeat certain numbers or words in my head to stop something bad from happening.
questions.ocir_16: I spend much longer in the shower than most people.
questions.ocir_17: My hands still feel dirty even right after I've washed them.
questions.ocir_18: I endlessly go back over the order of past events in great detail.

results.description: You don't have OCD symptoms that get in the way.
A score above 21 suggests obsessive thoughts or compulsive behaviors that are clinically significant.
